name: Stepped-on Flowers
source:
Two flowers from an all-girls catholic boarding school.
One flower is named Mallow, a perfectionist goody-two-shoes and straight A student.
Another is Hedera, the quiet loner who is hard to predict.

A destructive narrative about how repressing something will make it come out in the worst way possible.

[From [url=https://projectfoolsring.itch.io/stepped-on-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
